description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface and acts as a filter to pass only log messages without additional metadata over a chain of logging nodes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class for logging that passes only message content, stripping away other metadata, useful for on-screen log output.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Implements the LogNode interface; forwards only the message with minimal metadata to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
